run_build_targets: run selected gRPC build targets by name or label using the task runner CLI
run_prebuild_jobs: run pre-build jobspecs for selected targets before executing the main build phase
run_build_jobs_parallel: run build jobs in parallel with configurable concurrency using the jobs argument
filter_build_targets: filter build targets by label using AND semantics with the filter argument
generate_junit_xml_report: generate a JUnit XML sponge log report from the build job results
